title: Availability updates immediately when rent is created
gherkin:
Feature: Immediate Availability Synchronization
  Scenario: Item becomes unavailable immediately upon rent creation
    Given an item with id "ITEM-001" is available for the date range "2024-01-15" to "2024-01-20"
    When a rent record is created for item "ITEM-001" covering "2024-01-15" to "2024-01-18"
    Then the item availability query for "2024-01-15" to "2024-01-18" shall return unavailable status immediately
    And the item availability query for "2024-01-19" to "2024-01-20" shall return available status
rationale: Validates that availability changes are applied immediately when a rent record is created, ensuring real-time synchronization without delay. This is a core requirement from the operative context.
usedContextItems: The system shall update availability in real time when rent records are created, modified, cancelled, or completed.|The system shall return availability status indicating whether the item is available or unavailable for the requested period.|The system shall automatically update availability status when rent lifecycle events occur.
